name: maple avenue
description: the wider cross street that cuts through downtown, more traffic than main street. the sidewalks are broad and patched, lined with young maples that rustle in the breeze. a few cars pass, headlights sweeping the brick storefronts. there's a bus shelter at the corner and a faded mural on one wall. the air smells like damp pavement and faint exhaust, just a hint of coffee from the daily grind up the way.
